_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the judge returned them; each why is abridged by the run from the judge's report.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Cover and 5 pass the stage test, 4 has height and casts; 3 cold with flat glowing doors, 9's overexposed worker and cords in mid-air, 8 grey midtone, 2 brown midtone with fingers cropped.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Gold tape spine and camera move; 3 and 8 outside; value strobes across 6, 7, 8.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, quote verbatim; 5 sets company-wide targets in an implied US bay, corrected only on 9; 'two official records' looser than the sources.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; no utility, county or decision point.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover's dek tells the whole story; 4 is the real turn; 7 repeats the cover; 8 cuttable; 9 restates.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean with real place names; reads as filing summary.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Diverges from 66 to 68; lastLight and the vest figure familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Send the scout for the record naming who supplies the power and any ERCOT or PUC filing, so the deck can tell a Texan whose grid the wait sits on.

artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so the whole wall fits with one truck and person, warm rake, doors down.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Overexposed kit worker; cords in mid-air; about fourteen pads.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the camera for all twenty pads; cut or silhouette the worker.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey midtone rack wall, stock look.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to one rack face under one raking light.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Brown midtone field, fingers cropped, no tape corner.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darken outside a tight pool, fingers and tape corner in frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Near-white yard, missing jamb, plastic worker.
